c: You get an email when an order needs your approval.
say: When someone in your team orders an item that needs your approval, you get an email.

c: Open My Tasks: the item, who it's for, price and quantity.
say: Open My Tasks. The order shows the item, who it is for, its price, and quantity.

c: Approved, it goes to the next approval or to the teams who deliver it.
say: Press approve, and it goes to the next approval, or to the teams who deliver it.

c: Reject needs a reason; the request is closed and the requester told.
say: To reject, write why. The request is closed, and the requester is told.

c: Or reply with approve or reject in the subject.
say: You can also reply to the email with approve or reject in the subject, and your reason in the body.
